commit.message:
fix(clang-tidy): avoid unnecessary handle copies in sample sender/receiver (#1293)

Binds `handle` by `const auto&` in 4 places in
`sample_sender_receiver.cpp` instead of copying it, fixing the remaining
4 `performance-unnecessary-copy-initialization` alerts. `handle_result`
outlives each reference. `--config=ci` build of
`//score/mw/com/test/...` passes.
